How old is Jarrett Allen?

Jarrett Allen is 28 years old.

Jarrett Allen was born in San Diego, California.

Jarrett Allen was born on April 21, 1998.

How tall is Jarrett Allen?

Jarrett Allen is 6-9 (206 cm) tall.

How much does Jarrett Allen weigh?

Jarrett Allen weighs 243 lbs (110 kg).

Is Jarrett Allen in the Hall of Fame?

Jarrett Allen is not in the Hall of Fame.

Jarrett Allen was drafted by Brooklyn Nets, 1st round (22nd pick, 22nd overall), 2017 NBA Draft.

What position does Jarrett Allen play?

Center.

What is Jarrett Allen's net worth?

Jarrett Allen has made at least $110,034,582 playing professional basketball.

Jarrett Allen made $20,000,000 in 2022.

Jarrett Allen has won 0 championships.

What are Jarrett Allen's nicknames?
